target: NextEra-Brookfield Paducah AI Data Center Campus
notes: DOE, Brookfield and NextEra Energy announced a partnership (2026-07-29) to redevelop DOE's former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant (western KY, a shuttered Cold War uranium-enrichment site) into an AI data center campus. Brookfield leases the DOE site and will develop/operate the data center (targeting up to 1.8GW utility capacity / 1.2GW+ compute load by 2032); NextEra Energy builds dedicated on-site generation (a 2GW gas-fired plant plus up to 2.6GW battery storage). Total campus investment reported at 'more than $100B' by Bloomberg/trade press, but neither the DOE release nor the companies' own PR (PRNewswire: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/doe-site-in-western-kentucky-revitalized-with-data-center-campus-and-dedicated-energy-project-creating-jobs-and-protecting-residents-and-businesses-from-costs-302837752.html) breaks out Brookfield's capital slice vs NextEra's -- filed with amount_usd blank and amount_estimated=1 pending a disclosed split; round_total_usd carries the combined figure. NextEra Energy is not a currently-tracked allocator (see discovered_allocators.csv).
